findings.obs_text: In Exo 2:14 Moses is asked if he means to kill as he killed the Egyptian, and in fear thinks the thing is known. In 2Sa 21:16 the giant thought to kill David, and in Joh 16:2 the one who kills the disciples will think he serves God: the thought drives or excuses the killing. In Mat 15:19 and Mar 7:21 murder follows evil thoughts out of the heart, and in Luk 13:4 the hearers are asked whether those the tower killed were worse.
findings.grounds: whoever kills you will think he is offering service to God
